body:
Code Review by Qodo


1. Reviewers trust checks from another plan 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>checksBlock presents passed check IDs as proof of execution, but the reviewer's plan is selected
>independently of the approved plan used by CI. If a newer unapproved plan reuses a check ID for a
>different test command, the reviewer can assess that newer test while treating CI's pass for the
>older command as proof it ran.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The reviewer can receive a different plan from the one whose checks CI executed, while treating matching check IDs as execution facts. >## Fix Focus Areas >- .github/workflows/build-review.yml[185-193] >- scripts/lib/build-review-prompt.mjs[45-54] >## Recommended Fix >Select the reviewer's plan using CI's bot-authored, approved-plan selection rule, and associate the check result with that exact plan before presenting its IDs as facts. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/a337b457-39aa-4cb0-b28d-42fa22b91430?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/a337b457-39aa-4cb0-b28d-42fa22b91430)

View medium (3)
2. Old check results can pass as current 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>findChecksTable matches the head's first seven SHA characters anywhere in a bot comment instead of
>verifying the commit identified by the comment header. If posting the current result fails, an older
>sticky whose short SHA collides or whose captured output contains the current short SHA can be
>presented as current-commit evidence.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The renderer can accept an older check comment because it searches the whole body for a seven-character SHA. >## Fix Focus Areas >- scripts/lib/build-review-prompt.mjs[22-29] >- scripts/plan-checks.mjs[110-116] >## Recommended Fix >Have the CI producer emit a dedicated full-SHA field in the comment header, then require an exact match of that field before using the table. Fall back when no current-commit comment exists. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/998536ce-7aec-435b-8675-8459d9068807?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/998536ce-7aec-435b-8675-8459d9068807)
3. Test output can forge passed check rows 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>parseChecksTable accepts table-shaped lines anywhere in the bot comment, including the captured
>output of a plan command. A PR-controlled command can print a ✅ row for a manual check, causing
>the reviewer prompt to assert that CI ran that check even though the genuine table marks it for the
>owner.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >PR-controlled command output in the CI comment can be parsed as additional check results and promoted to factual instructions. >## Fix Focus Areas >- scripts/lib/build-review-prompt.mjs[34-41] >- scripts/lib/build-review-prompt.mjs[45-54] >## Recommended Fix >Bound parsing to the result table between its known header and the first following blank line. Reject duplicate IDs or conflicting statuses rather than treating them as additional results. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/c2e1bfbf-b21a-4b27-af9a-c2b78bd08644?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/c2e1bfbf-b21a-4b27-af9a-c2b78bd08644)
4. Manual steps go unlisted for the owner 📎 Requirement gap
>
>Description >
> >
>The ids('manual') branch of checksBlock tells the reviewer to name 🖐 rows only "in item 1's
>evidence", so the reviewer's output places them inside the Rule-held verdict. Compliance 4503409
>asks that manual lines be listed under the PR's How-to-test for the owner, and nothing in the
>rendered rubric or the workflow directs that placement. Because the wording is confined to item 1's
>evidence line, the owner may not find the manual checks in the How-to-test section where they are
>expected.
>
>
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The build reviewer prompt renderer names 🖐 manual plan-checks rows only inside item 1's evidence. Compliance 4503409 requires them to be listed under the PR's How-to-test section for the owner. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- scripts/lib/build-review-prompt.mjs[52-52] >- scripts/lib/build-review-prompt.test.mjs[61-67] >- .claude/agents/build-reviewer.md[13-13] > >## Recommended Fix >Change the manual-line sentence in `checksBlock` so it instructs the reviewer to list the 🖐 IDs under the PR's How-to-test section for the owner, keeping the "owner checks by hand" wording. Update the T3 assertion in the test file to match the new placement. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/7a8ff1c6-e2f1-4b43-befa-d0daa92778af?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/7a8ff1c6-e2f1-4b43-befa-d0daa92778af)
